desc: 两副装双色纸牌：并列白底、开盒平铺、牌桌铺陈与背纹微距
name: 双色两副装桌游扑克牌款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清是两副装纸牌，拿住点击率并满足纯白底合规
正面平视并列两副的既定配色，让买家一屏完成选款并确认成套件数
摊开外盒交代包装结构与内含两副，消除运输与开箱预期落差
把两副牌放进真实开局桌面，让买家代入聚会与牌局使用情境
用极低角度微距证明满版对称背纹套印精准、纸面挺括耐洗
以两副成组的收口陈列促成加购，留出上方空位供后期放行动号召

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm paper off-white #F2EEE7 for colour-choice and detail screens, deep indigo-slate felt #1B2A4A for table scene and closing frame
style.direction: clean tabletop-game commerce with printed-paper craft feel
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent colour, used only as blank plates on infographic screens
style.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadows that always ground the product, one skimming accent for print texture
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean tabletop-game commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm paper off-white #F2EEE7, deep indigo-slate felt #1B2A4A and one lacquer-red key accent #B4282D; neutral high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, bounce fill on the shadow side and soft contact shadows that always ground the product; matte felt and heavy paper surface language with visible card-stock edges and printed ink relief; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of frame; thin single-weight line icon style only as blank plates; paired units always level and identical in scale, stable slight 3/4 hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added brand marks or legible packaging text.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between the paired units
no added brand marks or legible packaging text
style.presentationRules: paired units always level and identical in scale, slight 3/4 hero angle reused across screens, symmetric geometric back pattern always reads as full-repeat and unbent
style.surfaceSystem: matte felt table plane #1B2A4A and heavy paper board #F2EEE7, visible card-stock edge and printed ink relief, no gloss plastic
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, kept out of frame for marketplace images; in-image copy is added in post-production only
